content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 4 to 5)
FLOWERING TIMES (20 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this part.
This task is about when plants flower. The number of hours of darkness affects when plants flower. In this investigation,
the number of hours of darkness \(+\) the number of hours of daylight \(= 24.\)
